description: This file implements the Administrator class within the Thunder::RPC namespace, managing RPC communication, proxy/stub registration, reference counting, and channel cleanup for a remote procedure call system.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and reference counting within the Thunder RPC system.

methods.name: Administrator::Administrator
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal data structures and flags.

methods.name: Administrator::~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: Administrator::Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Administrator class.

methods.name: Administrator::AddRef
methods.description: Adds a reference to an interface implementation associated with a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::Release
methods.description: Releases a reference to an interface implementation associated with a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::Release (overload)
methods.description: Completes a proxy call by invoking its Complete method.

methods.name: Administrator::UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Unregisters a proxy from the internal maps.

methods.name: Administrator::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method on a specified interface based on a message.

methods.name: Administrator::IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an instance is valid for a given channel and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given channel, instance, and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::RegisterUnknown
methods.description: Registers a new interface implementation with a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::UnregisterUnknown
methods.description: Unregisters an interface implementation from a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::Convert
methods.description: Converts a raw implementation pointer to a Core::IUnknown pointer based on stub registration.

methods.name: Administrator::DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel, releasing references and cleaning up associated proxies.
